How long until my idea looks expensive?

It depends on the scope, the feedback, and whether the brief changes shape halfway through. I'll set a realistic timeline before starting—no 'done by yesterday' promises.

Can you make my website look less like a tax form?

Can you fix a design that has seen things?

How much feedback do you need from me?
